positions.title: Associate 2 (Team lead, Solutions Architect)
positions.description:
Worked in a large organization using Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Pioneered a greenfield cloud application while the organization transitioned to a hybrid cloud by working with platform teams, enterprise architects, and product owners. Helped managers track progress and identify risks during sprints. Ran virtual meetings during Program Increment (PI) Planning to plan out 6 sprints worth of work. (AWS; Docker; Java; Jenkins; Jira; React; Redux; Scaled Agile Framework; Spring Boot)

Primary architect and developer for a notification system that integrated Twilio with Salesforce on Azure to deliver SMS notifications at scale. Helped migrate production data from legacy systems to Azure and Salesforce. Estimated costs and limits of Azure and Salesforce. (Azure, Salesforce Lightning and Apex)

positions.title: Associate 1 (Tech lead)
positions.description:
Technical lead and architect for a Direct-To-Customer web application. Researched best practices and advocated for standards during development. Coached junior front-end developers and assigned optimal tasks during agile ceremonies to maximize their growth while meeting target release date. Collaborated with various teams and stakeholders in the organization to ensure developers are not blocked.

Back-filled as a tech lead for a customer facing React/Redux web application. Worked with junior developers to create "game plans" for their stories every sprint. Worked with manager and team to tackle existing technical debt while still meeting release dates.

positions.title: Consultant 2
positions.description:
Designed and developed a Domain Specific Language that allowed a large healthcare provider to build dynamic user interfaces for multiple platforms. (iOS, Swift)

Full stack web developer for a cloud based e-commerce store. Built a catalog management application using Angular 5, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework Core, and PostgreSQL. Used Azure DevOps to continuously build and deploy dockerized .NET applications to a Kubernetes cluster. 

Researched and presented a proof of concept for conversational technology involving Alexa and Azure Cognitive Sciences.

positions.title: Consultant
positions.description:
Primary developer for a proof of concept mobile application for monitoring and gathering data of field equipment. Utilized Java for Android development and Amazon Web Services for storing, processing, and dispatching equipment data. Integrated a wireless vehicle bus adapter to deliver equipment data to the mobile application and cloud (Android; AWS). The project was delivered ahead of time and on budget.

Participated in an effort to enhance the suite of web applications that facilitated the planning and organizing of large events by developing a single-sign-on server (ASP.NET; Thinketure Identity Server) and integrating with a number of legacy applications. Worked with the client's infrastructure team to successfully deploy updates to all production applications with minimal downtime.

Full stack developer of a mobile mobile back office application. The application helped independent business owners order products and track downline sales. The application used Ionic / Angular for Android and iOS. The backend is implemented using ASP.NET Web API and integrated with an existing third party service, processed data, and stored data in an Azure document database.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Employed front end technologies such as AngularJS to develop a responsive single web application for both desktop and mobile browsers.

Researched and developed a front end architecture to be served by a .NET backend that utilizes ASP .NET Web API 2, NHibernate and Microsoft SQL Server to provide a data driven application.

positions.title: Application Developer Intern
positions.description:
Captured Dimensions is a startup company providing 3D printing and scanning services.

Work:

1. Created multiple applications using Qt, Python, and Django that is utilized by the company to coordinate tasks between offices and teams.
2. Researched and created POCs for technologies such as Celery and Redis to estimate value to the business.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Tekzenit, Inc. is a software and UX design company based in Irving, Texas.

Developed a web service that connects job seekers and employers via job boards, video portfolios, and skill matching.

Used ASP.NET MVC4, Razor, Entity Framework, and Microsoft SQL Server as well as other front-end technologies such as Twitter Bootstrap, jQuery and LESS.

Participated in Scrum meetings to collaborate with in-office and offshore project team members.

Developed a robust, reusable, and real-time datagrid to handle large amounts of data with an intuitive user interface.

Implemented a distributed, queue based email notification system that used mustache templates to send email notifications to users for a social media application. 

Ran meetings to knowledge transfer an Angular application to new team members before the end of summer.

projects.title: Coreference Resolution Project
projects.description: Created a Python application that estimates the correct pronouns given a sentence pair and a pair of candidate antecedents. Experimented with different Machine Learning concepts, such as decision trees, hidden layer neural networks, and naive bayes classifiers. Produced a working application with a satisfactory accuracy percentage via analysis of the problem domain.
